No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Greenwich-centred equatorial orthographic Earth recognition view retains its 150 mm spherical limb and sourced continental coast arcs. Coastal vertices are generalized with a 3 mm maximum simplification tolerance before clipping to a 4.5 mm centreline limb standoff; short fragments below 12.7 mm are omitted and explicitly listed. No coastline is invented or joined across an omitted gap. The terminal Scandinavian detail, narrow fjords and small near-limb fragments are intentionally absent. This is a coarse exterior recognition aid, not complete geographic/cartographic coverage, navigation, political boundaries or a scale measurement. North remains up; blank gaps do not imply water straits.", "canvas_mm": [170, 180]}, "teaching": "Greenwich-centred equatorial orthographic Earth recognition view retains its 150 mm spherical limb and sourced continental coast arcs. This is a coarse exterior recognition aid, not complete geographic/cartographic coverage, navigation, political boundaries or a scale measurement.
